description: Rejects cochain configurations where d3 circ d2 does not vanish identically or spectral floor is negative.
negative_fixture: On discrete lattices, d3 circ d2 = 0.04 != 0 due to discretization error.
positive_fixture: Discrete cochain algebra over Q satisfies d3 circ d2 = 0 exactly with spectral floor sigma >= 31/800.
